newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Tuan Sing buys tyre company.
newsitem.headline: Tuan Sing buys tyre company.

text.p: Diversified Tuan Sing Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had bought Singapore Bandag Pte Ltd, a tyre retreading company, for Singapore $6.6 million.
Singapore Bandag and its wholly-owned Malaysian subisidiary, Performance Retreads Sdn Bhd, both have a franchise agreement with Bandag Inc in the U.S. for a tyre retreading system.

Tuan Sing, which has interests in property development, civil engineering and building construction, said in a statement the acquisition would boost its trading division and complement its tyre distribution operations.

Tuan Sing entered the tyre market earlier this year when Indonesian tyre manufacturer PT Gadjah Tunggal appointed its subsidiary Globaltraco International sole distributor in a number of Southeast Asian countries and parts of West Africa.
